tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: List a bounded page of websites in the authenticated Supovia organization. Only safe website identity and status fields are returned; prompts, credentials, integration configuration, organization ids, and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

tools.name: get_website
tools.description: Fetch safe metadata for one website owned by the authenticated Supovia organization. Organization ids, agent prompts, credentials, integration configuration, and arbitrary metadata are never returned.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List a bounded newest-first page of conversation activity in the authenticated Supovia organization. Returns only the conversation id needed for an explicit follow-up, website id, channel, resolved state, unread count, and timestamps. Message bodies, message ids, customer identifiers, internal notes

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Summarize one organization-owned Supovia conversation using safe status fields and sender-category counts from at most 50 recent records. No message body, preview, message id, customer identifier, staff id, internal note, organization id, or arbitrary metadata is returned.

tools.name: get_unresolved_conversation_counts
tools.description: Count every unresolved conversation in the authenticated Supovia organization, grouped by website. Totals cover all returned count groups; the sorted per-website preview is capped at 100 and reports truncation. Customer identifiers, staff ids, message text, and organization ids are never returned.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List a bounded newest-first page of safe support-document metadata in the authenticated Supovia organization. Document content, embeddings, prompts, organization ids, and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch one support document owned by the authenticated Supovia organization, including its article text (capped at 20000 characters) and the contentFormat naming which syntax that text is written in (html, markdown, plain-text). A document owned by another organization returns the same bounded "not f

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search published support documents for one organization-owned Supovia website. Returns at most 5 safe document identities; content chunks, embeddings, scores, prompts, and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List a bounded page of campaign identities for one website owned by the authenticated Supovia organization. Recipient lists, subjects, message content, user ids, organization ids, and arbitrary metadata are excluded, and campaigns cannot be sent from this tool.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Idempotently send one exact operator reply in an organization-owned Supovia conversation. Reuse the same idempotencyKey only when retrying the same conversation and text. The result confirms the target and time without returning a message id or echoing the message body.

tools.name: resolve_conversation
tools.description: Mark one organization-owned Supovia conversation resolved, or reopen it. This is idempotent: re-sending the same state is a no-op write. It broadcasts a conversation-updated event to the operator dashboard. No other conversation field can be changed through this tool, and customer identifiers, staff

tools.name: show_support_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded organization-scoped snapshot of Supovia websites and recent conversations. Customer identifiers, internal record ids, message bodies, prompts, credentials, internal notes, organization ids, and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

tools.name: show_customer_inbox
tools.description: Open a metadata-only Supovia inbox and report only how many conversations have unread activity. The embedded view receives conversation ids needed for an explicit follow-up plus channel, status, unread count, and timestamps. It never receives message bodies, previews, message ids, customer details,

tools.name: open_customer_inbox_conversation
tools.description: Refresh safe activity metadata for one conversation selected in the embedded Supovia inbox. This app-only tool reads no thread and returns no message body, preview, message id, customer detail, or internal note.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_conversations, get_conversation, get_unresolved_conversation_counts, get_document, list_campaigns, show_customer_inbox, open_customer_inbox_conversation · Private data: list_websites, get_website, get_conversation, list_documents, get_document, search_documents, show_support_overview · Public sink: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_conversations, get_conversation, get_unresolved_conversation_counts, get_document, list_campaigns, show_customer_inbox, open_customer_inbox_conversation · Private data: list_websites, get_website, get_conversation, list_documents, get_document, search_documents, show_support_overview · Public sink: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
